_about: The forecast's inputs. The Model page (model/model.js) reads this file; edit here only. Counts come from scheduled FOMC meetings 1994-2026 (code/ in the research folder). Probabilities are 0-1.

base.state: Hold, last move a hike, one hold since

signal.note: Bias toward the next meeting in the minutes (or the statement if minutes are not out; voters' speeches if both read neutral, from June 2026). Counts: meetings 1999-2026 by the next meeting's direction.

unemployment.note: Change in the unemployment rate between meetings: up = +0.2pt or more, down = -0.2pt or more, else flat. Counts: intervals 1994-2026 by the next meeting's direction.
